title: docs(email-templates): copy the folded locale ladder of record into three stale texts
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ84dfchKnEZZMLPSx82D49u7)_
Fixes #29032

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:邮件模板 locale 解析的三处旧文字(文档页、metadata-core 文档注释、平台清单条目)改为照抄 spec 的 `SendTemplateInput.locale` 阶梯;无代码改动。
- 为什么改:#28880 起内置加载器会折叠语言子标签(zh → zh-CN)并先试声明的回退语言,三处仍写「精确匹配、不折叠」,QA 跑 main 会判错。
- 风险与回滚:仅文字与清单条目;回滚即 revert 本 PR。metadata-core 的注释随 `dist/index.d.ts` 发布,故带 patch changeset。
- 先看:`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/integration-system.json`(acceptance[3] 条款与 verify 行)、`content/docs/automation/email-templates.mdx`(Locale resolution 节)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:platform-checklist`,预期 exit 0。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Three texts outside `packages/spec` described the exact `(name, locale)` ladder that #28880 retired. Each now follows `SendTemplateInput.locale` in `packages/spec/src/contracts/email-service.ts` (landed with PR #29014), and keeps `en` and `en-US` as two rows of one bundle.

- `content/docs/automation/email-templates.mdx`, *Locale resolution*: the ladder is copied from the spec docblock: the named-locale ladder over the built-in loader (fold by `resolveBundleLocale`, then the declared fallback locale folded the same way, then `en-US`, then `TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND`), the replacement-loader exact ladder, and the no-locale ladder. The page names the spec docblock as the record.
- `packages/metadata-core/src/item-key-discriminators.ts`: the docblock no longer says the resolution is exact with no folding. It keeps its own rule of citing rather than quoting: it cites `SendTemplateInput.template` and `SendTemplateInput.locale` and keeps the one point the table rests on, that every rung loads one row at one tag exactly, so folding picks a row and never merges two.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/integration-system.json`, item `integration-system.email-template-render`: acceptance[3]'s clause copies the ladder; its verify line now scores a `zh` recipient getting the `zh-CN` row as the pass (it scored `en-US` before) and a `ja-JP` recipient getting `en-US` through the showcase's declared fallback `en`; steps[4] and variants[0] add those recipients; `automated.ref` no longer calls the uncovered half "the no-folding case" and names plugin-email's fold pins below the oracle's layer. Revision 12 → 13, one history row (ref #29032).
- `.changeset/29032-email-template-locale-ladder-docblock.md`: `@objectstack/metadata-core` patch. The docblock ships: after `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/metadata-core...' build`, its text is in `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/index.d.cts` (`grep -rl 'That resolution is exact' packages/metadata-core/dist` matched both on the base tree; positive control `ITEM_KEY_DISCRIMINATORS` matched `index.js`, `index.cjs` and both `.d.ts` files).

## Why

A QA run against `main` reads the checklist clause and scores the folding behaviour as a FAIL, and authors reading the docs page are told `zh` never reaches `zh-CN`. The producer is `EmailService.resolveAndRenderTemplate` in `packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/email-service.ts`, which matches the spec docblock (read at base `8ca9dd7b`).

## Tests

No behaviour changed, so there is no new test and no ablation. The ladder the texts now describe is pinned by `packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/template-locale-fold.test.ts` and `template-locale-fold.integration.test.ts`, untouched here.

## Acceptance notes

- The `TemplateLoader` interface docblock in `packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/email-service.ts` still says the loader resolves "under the exact rule below — there is no best match and no language-subtag folding". That stays true of `load()` itself (each call loads one tag exactly; the fold lives in the service), so it is not one of the stale texts and is left alone.
- The docs page and checklist clause cite the issue-free spec docblock as the record, so the next rewording on the spec side is one place to re-copy.
- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` was NOT MEASURED locally (exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it loads every package's built output and this worktree built only the closures below). It reads no file this diff changes beyond a comment in `metadata-core`; CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` runs it.

- 78 exited 0 on the first pass. Three exited 3 (prerequisite) and exited 0 on a rerun: `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` (after fetching its pinned fixture commit), `spec check:skill-examples` (after building `@objectstack/client` and `client-react`) and `check:lean-entry-closure` (after building `@objectstack/objectql`).
- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: exit 3, NOT MEASURED (see Acceptance notes).
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: "82 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 81 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED", exit 0.

<details><summary>docs build and the published docblock</summary>

- Docs build, the production command from `apps/docs/vercel.json` under `TURBO_FORCE=true`: `Tasks: 2 successful, 2 total`, `Cached: 0 cached`, and `apps/docs/.next/BUILD_ID` present.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-core build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-core typecheck`: VERDICT command-exit 0. After the rebuild, `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/index.d.cts` carry the new docblock and no longer contain "That resolution is exact".
</details>
